bio.text: James Eaton represents District 26 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which includes parts of Carroll, Madison and Franklin counties, and is serving his first term.
Eaton has a bachelor's degree in education from Arkansas Tech University and a master's degree in health education from the University of Central Arkansas.
He is an insurance agent and farmer who previously served on the Madison County Quorum Court, and lives in Kingston.
